findings.message: Multiple CMD instructions — only the last one takes effect
No HEALTHCHECK instruction — orchestrators can't determine container health
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost:PORT/health || exit 1

findings.message: Download without cleanup — downloaded archives may remain in layer
findings.fix: Download, extract, and remove archive in the same RUN instruction
findings.line: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates
